title: `payload` typed `any` where sibling handlers declare a payload interface
description: Sibling handlers in `orders.ts` and `users.ts` declare proper payload interfaces and narrow with `as` casts. `refunds.ts` uses untyped `any`. Fix: declare `interface RefundPayload { orderId: string; amountCents: number }` and narrow with `req.body as RefundPayload`.
